web-client.rationale: Jules has a browser client; mobile action parity was not established. Scope: Jules Tools remote-session CLI, Jules web/cloud.

cli.rationale: Jules Tools is an npm-installed remote-session CLI with a TUI dashboard. Scope: Jules Tools remote-session CLI, Jules web/cloud.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Tasks run in cloud-based VMs, separate from the browser client. Scope: Jules web/cloud.

local.rationale: Jules Tools controls remote Google-hosted workers; installing the client on a machine does not place coding-agent execution there.

own-server.rationale: Jules Tools controls remote Google-hosted workers; installing the client on a machine does not place coding-agent execution there.

vm.rationale: Each task runs in its own short-lived VM; no adversarial isolation test was run. Scope: Jules web/cloud.

parallel-runs.rationale: The guide lists Free/Pro/Ultra daily task caps of 15/100/300 and concurrent caps of 3/15/60, checked 7 November 2026; shutdown timing takes precedence. Scope: Jules web/cloud.

unattended-triggers.rationale: The dashboard supports scheduled recurring tasks with frequency and cadence. Scope: Jules web/cloud.

pr-workflow.rationale: Publish branch and Publish PR push results to GitHub; PR creation is separate from merging. Scope: Jules web/cloud.

review-ui.rationale: The feed includes mini diffs and a full changed-file diff editor. Scope: Jules web/cloud.

free-tier.rationale: Jules has a recurring no-cost plan during its remaining service window; read-only turndown is separately disclosed.

starting-price.rationale: The lowest recurring ADE fee is no cost; task limits and near-term turndown remain in the receipt.

laptop-independent.rationale: The FAQ explicitly says the autonomous cloud task continues after leaving the app.

free-plan.rationale: Free tier with daily limits beside Pro and Ultra.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete published Jules plans are a no-cost tier and Google AI Pro/Ultra subscription benefits with task quotas; no no-paid-plan Jules pricing option is listed. This retains the catalog pre-read-only plan scope, not a promise of new task access after November 11.

subscription.rationale: Published Pro and Ultra task limits were benefits of corresponding recurring Google AI plans. The service turndown overrides task access after November 11.
